title: Leveraging US Commercial Adjustments: MFN Tariffs and Trade Diversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.35986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most-favored-nation (MFN) tariff increases do more than raise trade costs. By changing the relative tariff treatment of competing exporters, they increase the value of existing trade preferences, reshaping relative market access and trade allocation. While the trade-reducing effects of higher tariffs are well established, much less is known about this mechanism. We investigate whether higher MFN tariffs amplify the competitive advantage of preferential partners, generating trade diversion. Using domestic and international trade data, we estimate a structural gravity model with CES-consistent bilateral tariff margins and examine recent changes in US trade policy as an empirical application. We find that higher MFN protection simultaneously reduces imports and redirects trade toward preferential exporters. These effects are highly heterogeneous across sectors and regions, with the largest losses concentrated in intermediate and capital goo

translated_title: 利用美国商业调整：最惠国关税与贸易转移
translated_abstract: 最惠国（MFN）关税的提高不仅仅是增加贸易成本。通过改变竞争性出口商之间的相对关税待遇，最惠国关税提升增加了现有贸易优惠的价值，重塑了相对市场准入和贸易分配格局。尽管较高关税的贸易减少效应已被充分证实，但人们对这一机制的了解却少得多。我们研究了更高的最惠国关税是否会放大优惠贸易伙伴的竞争优势，从而产生贸易转移。利用国内和国际贸易数据，我们估计了一个包含符合CES一致性双边关税边际的结构引力模型，并将近期美国贸易政策的变化作为实证应用。我们发现，更高的最惠国保护在减少进口的同时，会将贸易重新引导至享有优惠待遇的出口商。这些效应在各部门和各地区之间存在高度异质性，最大的损失集中在中间品和资本品领域。
tldr: 最惠国关税提高不仅会减少进口，还会通过提升现有贸易优惠的相对价值，将贸易转移至享有优惠待遇的出口国，且该效应在部门与地区间高度异质。
